mechanism: One direct system repair task references the mandatory native <REPAIR> subtask for a fixed half-hour; the parent direct-repair control has no task breakdown.
hypotheses_to_test: The direct repair task converts with a direct <REPAIR> reference and no user-defined SubTaskType row.
The half-hour subtask overrides the four-hour DIRPT, repair completes and the aircraft returns ready.
The failure and repair reconcile with the published D01 control except for the explicitly changed task breakdown and nominal main time.
All 16 populated tables roundtrip exactly, native outputs are nonempty, raw artifacts are sealed, and GUI/mutex guards hold.
limits: One fixed-seed direct system repair only; direct item repair, resources, additional subtasks and alternative timing remain unverified.
GUI-only behavior and cross-engine parity are unverified.
